design: Retrospective forward event transfer; specifications fixed before inspecting new experiment scores. Events were previously viewed; not preregistered or an untouched prospective test.
terra_note: Terra is the earliest training event, not scored using future events.
price_alignment: last provider sample <= cutoff, max age 7200s, no future samples or interpolation
flow_alignment: known Curve logs from previous state block exclusive to current state block inclusive; all subranges <=100 blocks; no capped/incomplete intervals accepted
gas_definition: baseFeePerGas of the cutoff state block in gwei; not transaction-paid or average gas price
lp_definition: multicoin liquidity amounts marked with cutoff-known USD prices; single-coin withdrawal token identity unavailable so event count only; invariant decline is confounded by fees/A, not identified LP flow
prediction_freeze: fit on past events only, before test event; no test-event fitting, residual updates or tuning
calibration: last 32 chronological training-event examples reserved; fit on all earlier examples; frozen 90% absolute-residual conformal interval, finite-sample ceil((n+1)*0.9) rank; no coverage guarantee under event shift
stress_definition: abs(actual USD price - 1) > 0.01; not issuer default
missing_data: exclude and record gaps, never fill with synthetic observations
structural_abm: Not fitted or validated by this forecast experiment
